title: Movies That Wreck You Emotionally
intro: Some films don't just move you, they leave a mark that stays for days. These six will hollow you out beautifully.

films.title: Requiem for a Dream
films.line: Four people chase their hungers until those hungers swallow them whole.

films.title: Prisoners
films.line: A father's love curdles into something dark and almost unrecognizable.

films.title: Incendies
films.line: A mother's secret unravels across continents and breaks you quietly from the inside.

films.title: Dancer in the Dark
films.line: She escapes into music and melody while the world closes in around her.

films.title: Hereditary
films.line: Grief arrives like a slow flood and then all at once it drowns you.

films.title: Oldboy
films.line: A man survives years of captivity only to face a truth far crueler than the cage.

films.title: Manchester by the Sea
films.line: Some grief does not heal, it just becomes the shape of the person carrying it.

films.title: Atonement
films.line: One childhood lie rewrites every life it touches, forever.

films.title: 21 Grams
films.line: Grief and guilt pull three strangers into each other's wreckage.

films.title: Blue Valentine
films.line: Falling in love and falling apart, played out in brutal parallel.
